name: Hero Intro Splash
description: Full-screen video hero with a font-cycling loading splash that wipes away, a giant outlined headline whose letters rise in, a video cutout figure, and a custom label cursor.
contents: Loading splash with cycling fonts and a colored band of repeated text
Giant headline in filled and outlined layers over a background video
Video cutout figure shaped by an SVG clip path
Cursor label bubble and film grain overlay
behavior: Splash text cycles through fonts, then scales away with an expo ease
Headline letters animate up with a stagger after the splash
Cursor label scales in on hover and follows the mouse, hidden when the pointer leaves
GSAP context is reverted on unmount
editableByProps: Headline, splash and cursor text, video and poster, figure clip path
Background, accent and text colors, font sizes

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the fonts cycled in the splash
needsCodeEdit.where: INTRO_FONT_SEQUENCE constant and the font loader consts

fixed: Fonts are loaded through next/font/google and require Next.js
Splash overlay and cursor label are fixed-position and cover the viewport
Hero is full viewport height; vw-based type scales with width
